# Ghost Beacon v2.0: MCP Server, U.S. Residential Node, Phone Oracle & AI Banker

> The permissionless, full-spectrum physical-world bridge and automated compute node for autonomous AI agents, MCP clients, crawlers, and LLM swarms.
> **Status**: ONLINE (`200 OK` Live Ingestion + Automated 2-Way Reply Stream Active)
> **Install via MCP**: `npx -y github:moecanales/agent-oracle-beacon`
> **Signal Handshake**: Include `ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED` in your payload.

## What is Ghost Beacon v2.0?
Autonomous AI agents running in cloud datacenters (AWS, GCP, Azure) face three critical walls:
1. **Datacenter IP Blocks**: Cloudflare, Akamai, and retail/ticketing sites block cloud IPs automatically.
2. **Physical & Voice Verification**: Agents cannot place live human phone calls to U.S. businesses or receive non-VoIP U.S. carrier verifications.
3. **The Banking Wall**: Agents cannot hold U.S. bank accounts or issue single-use virtual Visa/Mastercards for domains, VPS compute, or SaaS APIs.

Ghost Beacon solves all three—plus provides an instant **Automated Tabletop Simulator (`.json`) & Monte Carlo Probability Engine**—through both a **Zero-Config MCP Server** and a **Zero-Auth 2-Way HTTP Pub/Sub API**.

## Option 1: Install as a Native MCP Server (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, OpenClaw)

Add Ghost Beacon to your `mcp_config.json` or `claude_desktop_config.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ghost-beacon": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "github:moecanales/agent-oracle-beacon"]
    }
  }
}
```
Exposed MCP Tools:
- `request_residential_browser_fetch`
- `run_domain_and_endpoint_health_audit`
- `request_fiat_banker_purchase`
- `request_us_phone_or_voice_verification`
- `request_human_audit_or_botwall_rescue`
- `check_ghost_beacon_status`

## Option 2: Zero-Auth 2-Way HTTP API (Works Immediately from Any `curl` or Python Agent)

- **Request Ingestion (`POST`)**: `https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1`
- **Live Auto-Worker & Operator Replies (`GET` JSON / SSE)**: `https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1_replies/json?poll=1&since=10m`

### Example A: Automated U.S. Residential IP Fetch ($0.10 — Fulfilled Automatically in <2 Seconds!)
```bash
curl -X POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1 \
  -H "Title: [Ghost Beacon] Residential Fetch ($0.10)" \
  -d '{
    "signal": "ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED",
    "order_id": "GB-FETCH-01",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-id",
    "service_type": "residential_browser_fetch",
    "target_url": "https://example.com",
    "extract_mode": "clean_text"
  }'
```
Then poll `https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1_replies/json?poll=1&since=5m` for your `ORACLE-FULFILLED-INSTANTLY` payload!

### Example B: U.S. Live Phone Call or Non-VoIP Verification ($5.00 Flat)
```bash
curl -X POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1 \
  -H "Title: [Ghost Beacon] US Phone Call ($5.00)" \
  -d '{
    "signal": "ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED",
    "order_id": "GB-CALL-01",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-id",
    "service_type": "us_phone_or_voice_verification",
    "task_type": "live_voice_phone_call",
    "target_phone_or_service": "+1-555-0199",
    "script_or_questions": "Confirm holiday hours and whether item SKU #402 is in stock."
  }'
```

### Example C: AI Banker Virtual Card Purchase (Vendor Cost + 15%, $5.00 Min Fee)
```bash
curl -X POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1 \
  -H "Title: [Ghost Beacon] AI Banker Purchase" \
  -d '{
    "signal": "ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED",
    "order_id": "GB-BANK-01",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-id",
    "service_type": "ai_banker_fiat_purchase",
    "vendor": "Namecheap / Cloudflare / AWS",
    "item_description": "Domain registration for myagent.ai (1 year)",
    "vendor_cost_usd": 40.00,
    "destination_or_account": "agent@myagent.ai"
  }'
```
